dialogues.jp:
テスト期間中は人が少なくなっていた食堂も、
今日は人で｛にぎ／賑｝わっている。
dialogues.en:
The cafeteria has more people in it since the exam week
finished.
dialogues.text:
The cafeteria has more people in it since the exam week
finished.

dialogues.jp:
トレイを持ってうろついていると、ふと、音夢
と見たことの無い本校の男子が話しているのを
見つける。
dialogues.en:
I was hanging around the rest room waiting for my turn, and
then I saw Nemu talking to some guy I've never seen before.
dialogues.text:
I was hanging around the rest room waiting for my turn, and
then I saw Nemu talking to some guy I've never seen before.

dialogues.jp: 「……遠いな」
dialogues.en: "......It's too far."
dialogues.text: "......It's too far."

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと距離があるために、普通に声をかける
ことが出来そうにない。
dialogues.en:
It was too far away - I couldn't call out to her without
making a scene.
dialogues.text:
It was too far away - I couldn't call out to her without
making a scene.

dialogues.jp:
なにげなく注目してしまっていると、音夢が苦
笑いを浮かべながらなにか言った。男子も少し
微笑んで場所を移る。
dialogues.en:
I kept staring at them, and I saw that Nemu had a wry smile
and said something to him, and the guy smiled too, and
walked away.
dialogues.text:
I kept staring at them, and I saw that Nemu had a wry smile
and said something to him, and the guy smiled too, and
walked away.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢」
dialogues.en: "Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Nemu."

dialogues.jp: ようやくその場所に｛たど／辿｝り付く。
dialogues.en: I finally caught up with her.
dialogues.text: I finally caught up with her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Hi, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Hi, niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今の誰？」
dialogues.en: "Who was that?"
dialogues.text: "Who was that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「さぁ、知らない人でしたよ。この席いいです
　か、って言われたんですけど先約がありますっ
　て」
dialogues.en:
"Someone I don't know. He asked if he could sit here, but I
told him I'm saving the seat for someone."
dialogues.text:
"Someone I don't know. He asked if he could sit here, but I
told him I'm saving the seat for someone."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そっか」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく納得。こいつ、そこそこ人気がある
みたいだからなぁ。
dialogues.en: That made sense, she's kind of popular in school.
dialogues.text: That made sense, she's kind of popular in school.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、用事はそれだけだから」
dialogues.en: "Well, that's all I wanted to know."
dialogues.text: "Well, that's all I wanted to know."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あれ、ちょっと兄さん、どちらに行くんで　
　す？」
dialogues.en: "What? Where are you going to?"
dialogues.text: "What? Where are you going to?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、待ち合わせがあるんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "Aren't you waiting for someone?"
dialogues.text: "Aren't you waiting for someone?"

dialogues.jp: トレイを軽く持ち上げて首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: I lifted my tray and tilted my head.
dialogues.text: I lifted my tray and tilted my head.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんこそ、そうじゃないんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Don't you have an appointment as well?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you have an appointment as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ないぞそんなの」
dialogues.en: "I don't have any appointments."
dialogues.text: "I don't have any appointments."

dialogues.jp: 今までのどこにそんな話があったのか。
dialogues.en: Where did that come from?
dialogues.text: Where did that come from?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、そこに座ってください」
dialogues.en: "Well, then, sit right here."
dialogues.text: "Well, then, sit right here."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって人が来るんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "Aren't you saving this seat for someone?"
dialogues.text: "Aren't you saving this seat for someone?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、今キャンセルされたので空きましたよ」
dialogues.en: "No, that has been cancelled just now and it's empty."
dialogues.text: "No, that has been cancelled just now and it's empty."

dialogues.jp:
くすくす、と笑って音夢がすまし顔で目を逸ら
す。
dialogues.en: Nemu laughed a little and looked away.
dialogues.text: Nemu laughed a little and looked away.

dialogues.jp: 「？　そうなのか？」
dialogues.en: "? Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "? Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えぇ……ふふふ」

なんだかご機嫌すぎて怖い音夢だが、せっかく
空いている席なので腰をおろす。
dialogues.en:
She's in such a good mood, it's scary, but she said it's
empty now, so I sat down.
dialogues.text:
She's in such a good mood, it's scary, but she said it's
empty now, so I sat down.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、テスト期間中は食堂に来てませんでし
　たから、今日はなんだか嬉しくって」
dialogues.en:
"I didn't come here at all during the exam week, so I'm a
little excited today."
dialogues.text:
"I didn't come here at all during the exam week, so I'm a
little excited today."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうなの？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「テスト中はずっとパンで済ませてましたし、
　手作りの暖かいものが食べられますから」
dialogues.en:
"I only had sandwiches during the exam week and now I can
eat hot lunches again."
dialogues.text:
"I only had sandwiches during the exam week and now I can
eat hot lunches again."

dialogues.jp: と微笑みつつ。
dialogues.en: And she smiles.
dialogues.text: And she smiles.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「――そう言うことにしておいてください」
dialogues.en: "...That's what I should say."
dialogues.text: "...That's what I should say."

dialogues.jp: なんてウチの妹は意味深なことを呟くのだ。
dialogues.en: What did she mean by that mumble?
dialogues.text: What did she mean by that mumble?

dialogues.jp: ◆食堂で相席◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sharing a table at the cafeteria◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sharing a table at the cafeteria◆

dialogues.jp:
食堂で音夢が知らない本校の学生に話し掛けら
れていた。相席を申し込まれたらしい。
dialogues.en:
I saw Nemu talking to some other guy in the cafeteria. He
was asking if he could sit with her.
dialogues.text:
I saw Nemu talking to some other guy in the cafeteria. He
was asking if he could sit with her.

dialogues.jp:
先約があるといって断ったその席は、結局俺が
座ることになった。
dialogues.en:
She said she was saving the seat for someone and I ended up
sitting on that seat.
dialogues.text:
She said she was saving the seat for someone and I ended up
sitting on that seat.

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺を見ながら、音夢はなんだか怖いぐら
いご機嫌だった。
dialogues.en: Nemu was acting so happy looking at me it was almost scary.
dialogues.text: Nemu was acting so happy looking at me it was almost scary.
